name: example-agency-practice
title: practice page kind
description: A static local clinical or appointment practice page kind: hero with a book call, services or treatments, provider credentials, what to expect at a visit, a book step whose destination is honestly classified from a supplied URL, phone or email, optional patient or client reviews, optional insurance or pricing, optional FAQ, and optional hours and location (text only, no map). Fits a dentist, veterinarian, medical specialist, physiotherapist or aesthetics/med-spa practice. Composed from twelve vendored HyperUI blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the practice family for a static local clinical or appointment practice mock: a hero with a book call, services or treatments, provider credentials, what to expect at a visit, a book step, and optional reviews, insurance or pricing, FAQ, and hours and location. Ask for the business, its services, its providers and how a visitor books, generate a schemaVersion 2 practice typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder. Not a signed-in patient portal, and not a studio, agency, property estimate, restaurant reservation or membership institution.
